strategic_assessment.headline: The funnel has 13 breaks and content hasn't started — more outreach volume right now is pouring water into a leaking bucket.
strategic_assessment.body:
Three things are true this week that pull in different directions. Your content flywheel hasn't started but your outreach is live. That's backwards, because social proof before POSSIBLE would have made every Nell email land harder. The funnel has 13 breaks and zero paying clients, which means more outreach volume isn't the lever right now, fixing conversion is.

Leo identified the problem: no prices on Sprint pages, dead schema.org markup indexing wrong products at wrong prices, CTAs going nowhere. These aren't edge cases — they're the entire funnel. Nobody can buy even if they want to.

The correct sequencing: fix the three funnel breaks this week, then open the floodgates. Three decisions from Krish unlock everything: approve Leo's top 3 fixes (15 min), greenlight the Bob Pittman draft (5 min), approve Cleo's content plan (10 min). Thirty minutes of decisions unblocks the entire org.
strategic_assessment.recommended_focus: Approve Leo's top 3 funnel fixes, greenlight the Bob Pittman draft, approve Cleo's 2-week content plan. Three decisions, 30 minutes, unblocks conversion, outreach, and content simultaneously.
